purpose: Add isolated one-shot database connectivity probe and default-off explicit secure-ingress mode for owner-authorized Railway testing
constraints: Root sole publisher; local workers do not publish.
Probe opens a policy-validated connection and SELECT 1 only; sanitized output, no host startup or credential output.
Reuse current scoped SQL TLS policy unchanged; do not enable certificate exceptions.
Ingress mode default off; no forwarded-header trust or environment auto-detection; preserve host, Origin, CSRF, cookies and authorization.
No real SQL, private configuration or Tools.dll in source, images or CI.
Owner approved Railway ingress activation only after code and tests pass; activation remains a separate verified step.
ERP login, private DLL provisioning, native permissions and business writes remain unaccepted.
